title: Verwijzing naar de data van: The principle of open justice - Observations of court sessions and interviews with attendants
descriptions: This project investigates the openness of trials and the views of citizens on accessibility of courts, by making systematic observations and interviewing people sitting in public galleria.
Data available in consultation with NSCR. Please contact the datamanager [datamanagement@nscr.nl]
description: This project investigates the openness of trials and the views of citizens on accessibility of courts, by making systematic observations and interviewing people sitting in public galleria.

relations.text: Marijke Malsch; Hans Nijboer; F. van den Berg; I. de Bruijn; H. Buist	Malsch, M. & Hoekstra, R. (1999). De publieke tribune: controlemiddel voor de rechtspraak of opvangruimte voor daklozen? Delikt & Delinkwent, 29, 737-755.

data_sources: Court sessions in all Dutch criminal courts (N = 263 observations, 95 interviews). In all Dutch criminal courts, trials have been visited. Systematic observations have been conducted with help of a checklist, and people sitting in the public galleries have been interviewed.
